d:
Shri hanumanashtak aadity garhvi ke bhavyukt svar men. sankatmochan hanumanashtak ki sanrachna gosvami tulsidas ne ki thi. mana jata hai ki sankatmochan hanumanashtak ka path karne se vyakti apni har badha aur pira se mukt ho jata hai aur uske sabhi sankat dur ho jate hain.
Watch the video song of "Bhayo Suraj Uday Andhiyaro Gayo" now!
Lavnasur ke sath yudh karke shatrughan use mrityu ke ghat utar deta hai. lavnasur ki mrityu se madhura ki sari praja evan rishi muni khushiyan manate hain.
"svar- ravindr jain aur sathi
Git- ravindr jain
Sangit- ravindr jain"
